label: BOARD_REFERENCE_AUDIT_V1
rationale: Fixed rule: minimize the median |ref - dominant stable raw level| across all HURDLE dives with credible diver support (scored dives=['1040', '2169', '524', '2341', '2353', '2555']; scores={'B0': 0.00139, 'B1': 0.00098, 'B1r': 0.00098, 'B2': 0.00095}); near-ties (<= 0.005) prefer B1r>B1>B2>B0. Chosen: B1r. Evidence: (1) B0 inherits contamination at prep_end — on 1040 it lands between the two apparent levels (matches neither); on 2541 the initial 'plateau' is a low-confidence non-diver target (conf<0.10) so B0 is silently wrong while B1/B2 degrade to None (detectable) because no credible support cluster exists. (2) On every dive where the cluster exists, B1/B1r match the dominant stable level within ~0.01 and B2 corroborates B1 (bbox-bottom anchor agrees to ~0.003-0.02), so the extra bh conversion step in B2 adds no accuracy. (3) B1r ~= B1 after MAD rejection on these clusters. B1 is therefore the chosen reference: GT-blind, robust to single-frame outliers, and fails LOUD (None) rather than silently when support is absent.
note: Descriptive audit only. No Event Logic parameter was modified; no threshold was selected from these distributions.
